# Log in pages: Split with image (Default)

The default: the sign-in of a hospital referral portal. Form on the start side, brand panel with the image, process icons and system name on the end side. Try an empty submit, or the password “wrong”.

A complete standalone component built only from `@mod-internal/ui`, Angular and plain CSS with the library tokens. Copy it, rename the selector and class, replace the sample text and data with the project's own (and its translation mechanism), and keep the structure.

import {

@Component({

  template: `

      [panelIcons]="['medical-file', 'hospital-bed-01', 'patient']"
    >
      <img modAuthLogo src="assets/img/logo.svg" width="132" height="136" alt="Organization name" />
      <button modAuthActions mod-button variant="secondary-outline" size="medium" type="button" (click)="toggleLanguage()">
        <mod-icon name="language-square" /> عربي

      <mod-auth-header

      <form [formGroup]="form" (ngSubmit)="submit()" novalidate style="display: grid; gap: var(--spacing-2xl);">
        @if (failed()) {

        }

        <mod-text-input
          label="User name"
          formControlName="userName"

          [helperText]="invalid('userName') ? 'This field is required' : ''"

        <mod-text-input

          type="password"
          formControlName="password"
          autocomplete="current-password"
          passwordToggle
          required
          [error]="invalid('password')"
          [helperText]="invalid('password') ? 'This field is required' : ''"
        />

        <button mod-button type="submit" style="width: 100%;" [disabled]="busy()">
          {{ busy() ? 'Signing in...' : 'Sign in' }}

export class SignIn {
  protected readonly form = new FormGroup({
    userName: new FormControl('', { nonNullable: true, validators: Validators.required }),
    password: new FormControl('', { nonNullable: true, validators: Validators.required }),
  });
  protected readonly busy = signal(false);
  protected readonly failed = signal(false);

  protected invalid(name: 'userName' | 'password'): boolean {
    const control = this.form.controls[name];
    return control.invalid && (control.touched || control.dirty);
  }

  protected toggleLanguage(): void {
    const root = document.documentElement;
    root.dir = root.dir === 'rtl' ? 'ltr' : 'rtl';
  }

  protected async submit(): Promise<void> {
    this.failed.set(false);
    if (this.form.invalid) {
      this.form.markAllAsTouched();
      return;
    }
    this.busy.set(true);
    try {
      const { userName, password } = this.form.getRawValue();
      // await this.auth.login(userName, password);
    } catch {
      this.failed.set(true);
      this.form.controls.password.reset('');
    } finally {
      this.busy.set(false);
    }
  }
}
